title: The uniquely normalized ordinary Cartier class
statement: For n>0, a finite commutative ring A killed by n, and an effective Cartier immersion i:D→Z with n invertible on Z, define the ordinary degree-two Ext class to be the unique class satisfying SupportedKummerBoundary [def-asd-ordinary-supported-kummer-boundary]. Existence and uniqueness are the corresponding clause of [lem-asd-ordinary-supported-kummer].

def geoCartierEtaleClass (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (hA : (n : A) = 0) {D Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (i : D ⟶ Z) [IsClosedImmersion i] (hI : i.ker.IsInvertible)
    (hZ : IsUnit (n : Γ(Z, ⊤))) :
    Ext ((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) i).obj (ordinaryFiniteConstant A D))
      (Scheme.finiteEtaleTateLine Z n A hA) 2
